This reference lists every route Sift answers, grouped by what it's about. The full schema is the [OpenAPI file](https://github.com/nuvibes/sift/blob/main/frontend/openapi.json) in the source tree. The routes serve Sift's own browser client and desktop app, and they change between releases without notice.
